concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paybright-android-component]] — 2026-09-15 PayBright Android Redirect Component guide for an existing Advanced integration, with Adyen's no-new-integrations notice and capture/refund example caveats.
warnings: Opening no-new-PayBright-integrations notice qualifies later Customer Area setup instructions; Sessions links conflict with Advanced requirement, and partial-capture example values are inconsistent.
The Java and Go dateOfBirth snippets at raw lines 199 and 566 cannot be used as shown: Java rejects the date-only string and Go ignores the RFC3339 parse error.
The partial-refund example at raw lines 982–988 has empty currency strings, in addition to its Checkout refunds link versus legacy /refund body mismatch.
